findings.source: Hunter: Ну давай, покажи хоть одну нормально работающую больницу! После лечения посмотришь в глаза мне.
findings.currentTarget: Hunter: Basi nionyeshe hospitali moja tu inayofanya kazi vizuri! Ukishatibiwa utanitazama machoni.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Hunter: Basi nionyeshe hospitali moja tu inayofanya kazi vizuri! Nikishatibiwa utanitazama machoni.
findings.objectiveReason: The preceding Hunter_Eyes node establishes that Hunter has persistently painful injured eyes. The treatment is needed before the player inspects Hunter’s eyes again. Ukishatibiwa explicitly makes the player the patient and changes that contextual fact.
